BiblicalUsage: Parabatēs is the transgressor, the law-breaker. Circumcision profits if you keep the law, but if you are a breaker of the law your circumcision is made uncircumcision; Paul says if I build again the things I destroyed, I make myself a transgressor; and James says he who said Do not commit adultery said also Do not kill.
TheologicalSignificance: I hold that the transgressor is not the man who never heard the law but the man who heard it and broke it. I am that man apart from Christ.
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
